capture.classification: NCU profile-only capture; each worker reports one profiled run after three warmups.
capture.csv_rows: header, units, one kernel data row per arm
capture.raw_values: CSV values and units are preserved as strings without rounding or unit conversion.

limitations: NCU profile duration is profiler output, not an unprofiled benchmark speed result.
One profiled kernel launch per arm; this capture does not provide repeated unprofiled latency statistics.
PC-sampling stall counters are raw sampled warp counts, not percentages of execution time; sample counts differ between arms.
The counters describe these captured launches and do not alone establish a causal explanation for performance.
